reason: Last year at home was a squeeze, and for the whole preschool group I need a proper room. Run through my spreadsheet, MINI comes out at 550 + 7×40 = 830 zł for 15 kids, which is acceptable for an exclusive room 10 minutes from home with a 4.9 rating, so I'd book it if there's a free weekend slot.
objection: The add-ons pile up: per-child surcharges, extra fees for café staff once there are more adults, and the ban on bringing our own cakes for adults means another 170-190 zł at their prices. In the end 550 turns into well over a thousand.
would_change_my_mind: If there's no free Saturday or Sunday slot within a month of the birthday, I'll go to another venue.
